title: Retaining wall construction
scope: Construct retaining wall up to 3m retained height including excavation, foundation, wall structure, drainage layer, backfill and surface finish, excluding specific engineering design.
research_need: Wall type, retained height, surcharge, foundation conditions, drainage and consent requirements

title: Channel drain installation to paving
scope: Supply and install proprietary polymer/concrete channel drain with grate to trafficable or footpath paving, including concrete haunching and connection to nearest stormwater line, per metre of run.
research_need: Channel/grate load class rates, haunch concrete quantity, connection depth and paving reinstatement

title: Suspended tile ceiling supply install
scope: Supply and install exposed-grid suspended ceiling with mineral fibre or similar lay-in tiles, including hangers and seismic bracing, to regular open ceiling areas.
research_need: Tile type/NRC, grid system, ceiling height and seismic restraint standard.

title: Mains and feeder cable installation
scope: Supply and install main incoming and sub-main feeder cables with containment and terminations between switchboards, priced per metre of installed run.
research_need: Cable size and type, route length, containment, termination and copper price basis

title: Internal doorset supply and install
scope: Supply and install a single internal door leaf with frame, hung and adjusted, priced per leaf type, frame material and opening height, excluding hardware and vision panels.
research_need: Rates by leaf core, fire/acoustic rating, timber vs steel frame, opening height

title: Solar array mounting structural support
scope: Structural design, supply and installation of roof or ground mounting support for a solar PV array, including purlin or rafter strengthening and fixings, excluding electrical work.
research_need: Array size and weight, roof structure capacity, strengthening extent, PS1 fee

title: Aluminium composite panel cladding
scope: Supply and fix aluminium composite or sheet wall cladding on existing framing/substrate up to 10m height, including fixings, subgirts and standard flashings, measured by cladding face area.
research_need: Panel system rates, subgirt spacing, access method and flashing extent per m2

title: Switchboard fault rating and protection
scope: Fault level assessment, busbar bracing upgrade and supply/installation of correctly rated protection devices to an existing or new switchboard.
research_need: Prospective fault current, breaker kA ratings, discrimination study and design fees

title: Solar connection switchboard works
scope: Switchboard and distribution board works for PV grid connection including solar supply switch, dedicated solar board and associated upgrade of existing boards.
research_need: Inverter capacity, board modification extent, export limits and network approval

title: Facade and soffit coating
scope: Prepare and apply two-coat exterior coating system to plastered, concrete, steel panel or soffit surfaces up to 10m height, including access, measured by coated area.
research_need: Coating system spec, substrate prep, number of coats and access type

title: Glazed vision panel to door
scope: Cut, frame and glaze a vision panel into a door leaf, including beads and glass to rating, priced per panel up to 300x900mm.
research_need: Factory versus site cut cost, fire-rated glazing rates, leaf rating impact

title: Site establishment and compound relocation
scope: Relocating or reconfiguring temporary site fencing, sheds, stockpile and material storage areas within an operating construction site, excluding new hardstand construction.
research_need: Fence length, shed size, crane/hiab needs, number of moves, standing time rates

title: Door hardware set installation
scope: Supply and install ironmongery per leaf - locksets, closers, security and roller door hardware - fitted to an already hung door, excluding access control wiring.
research_need: Rates for standard, security and closer sets by grade and finish

title: External concrete paving and slabs
scope: Construct reinforced concrete external paving or yard slab on prepared subbase, including formwork, mesh, falls to design levels, joints and finish, up to 200mm thick.
research_need: Slab thickness, reinforcement, subbase depth, surface finish, joint layout and area size

title: Metering and control wiring installation
scope: Install and terminate small-gauge control, instrumentation and monitoring cabling to water meters, irrigation controllers and field devices, including containment within a site.
research_need: Cable type, run lengths, termination counts and BMS interface points

title: Garden bed planting installation
scope: Supply and planting of trees, shrubs and groundcover into prepared garden beds including topsoil, staking and establishment period, excluding turf, mulch and irrigation.
research_need: Species schedule, plant grades, densities, topsoil depth and maintenance period length.

title: Structural steel connection fabrication upgrades
scope: Fabrication and installation of revised or added steel connections - cleats, brackets, weld plates, bolted and welded joints - on members already in the contract, priced per connection.
research_need: Connection type, plate/weld size, shop versus site work, inspection requirements

title: Glass splashback supply install
scope: Supply and install toughened back-painted glass or tiled splashback to kitchen and kitchenette benches, including templating, cutouts for services and silicone fixing.
research_need: Glass type/colour, panel sizes, number of cutouts and wall substrate.

title: Internal stud partition wall construction
scope: Supply and erect steel or timber stud partitions to a documented wall type, including plasterboard both faces, insulation, stopping ready for decoration, floor to underside of ceiling or slab.
research_need: Wall type build-up, height, fire/acoustic rating and stopping level required.

title: Deflection head and acoustic seal
scope: Form head-of-wall deflection detail to timber or steel framed partitions with compressible acoustic seal and slip track, measured per linear metre of wall head.
research_need: Deflection allowance, acoustic/fire rating and proprietary head track system

title: Benchtop and laminate panel
scope: Supply and install benchtops and compact laminate panels to existing cabinetry or framing, including cutouts and edging, priced per lineal metre of run.
research_need: Rates by benchtop material, thickness, edge detail and cutout count

title: Network supply connection and metering
scope: Lines-company supply point connection, HV/LV metering unit installation and configuration including network fees, coordination and energisation for one connection.
research_need: Network operator fee schedule, metering CT class, connection lead times

title: Fire sprinkler system installation
scope: Supply and install wet pipe sprinkler system to an existing approved design within a single building, including pipework, heads, valve set and commissioning, excluding pump, tank and hydraulic design.
research_need: NZS 4541 head spacing, hazard class, per m2 sprinkler rates by building type

title: Interior finishes to schedule
scope: Supply and install of miscellaneous interior finishes nominated on a finishes schedule not covered by a dedicated trade, including wall, floor and feature finishes in fitout areas.
research_need: Finishes schedule items, quantities and which trades are already covered.

title: Subgrade preparation and basecourse replacement
scope: Undercut of unsuitable subgrade, disposal and replacement with compacted GAP40/65 basecourse to 300mm, in trafficked pavement or slab areas.
research_need: GAP supply and cart rates, disposal costs and undercut depth assumptions

title: Industrial roller and specialist doors
scope: Supply and install industrial door units - roller, roller shutter, high speed or specialist - up to 5x5m opening including tracks, motor and commissioning, excluding structural opening works.
research_need: Rates by door type, opening size, motorisation and cycle speed

title: Joinery finishing and painting
scope: Prepare, prime and finish coat site or factory joinery surfaces, priced per m2, covering paint, stain or clear lacquer systems on standard substrates.
research_need: Rates per m2 for paint, stain and lacquer systems, factory versus site

title: Emergency lighting and exit signage
scope: Supply, install and test maintained emergency luminaires and exit sign fittings including circuit wiring and AS/NZS 2293 discharge testing certification.
research_need: Fitting type and count, wiring runs, 90-minute test and certification cost

title: Site electrical reticulation and services
scope: Installation of site-wide electrical reticulation, services layout equipment, pits, conduits and general electrical services fitout across an external site area.
research_need: Reticulation route lengths, conduit sizes, pit counts and excavation interface

title: Data rack and network hardware
scope: Supply and install communications rack, patch panels, network switches and rack-terminated structured cabling for one comms room or cabinet.
research_need: Rack size, port counts, switch specification and cable certification testing
